summary: Catalonia, computer science background, expertise in microkernel architecture, strong preference for open-source software, interest in operating systems (Minix, HURD, Genode), active in discussions about software reliability and security, critical of proprietary software and corporate practices, advocates for free software in education, uses LineageOS on OnePlus 3, prefers Amiga and retro computing, engaged in discussions about political and social issues, skeptical of mainstream tech companies, supports privacy and encryption in communication tools, critical of Linux kernel vulnerabilities, prefers BSD systems for performance and reliability.
